result.title: MM-SystemOneBias: Evaluating Bias in Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
result.summary: When multimodal decision models determine actions, moderation outcomes, or quality judgments, their reliability depends on preserving semantic decisions across presentation changes, ignoring irrelevant additions, and distinguishing information consistent with task evidence from information that conflicts with it. Existing evaluations study decision-interface biases and multimodal model behavior in separate settings, leaving no common protocol to compare multimodal decision models with their backbones on practical tasks. We introduce \textbf{MM-SystemOneBias}, which evaluates 13 models on 5,323 original instances from nine public datasets and 11 task scenarios using six paired interventions: option order, option label, external judgment, image--text description, irrelevant information, and rating scale. Across seven matched decision-model--backbone pairs, decision models are more stable under option-label, irrelevant-information, and rating-scale changes in all seven pairs; six pairs also show lower option-order flip rates. They incur smaller accuracy losses under incorrect external judgments in all seven pairs and conflicting descriptions in six. In six pairs, they gain less accuracy from correct external judgments and show less favorable accuracy changes under consistent descriptions. Among pairs with unchanged semantic decisions, mean absolute changes in answer probabilities range from 4.56 to 11.55 percentage points, revealing input effects that accuracy alone misses.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MM-SystemOneBias，在 9 个公开数据集、11 类任务场景的 5,323 个实例上，用六种配对干预（选项顺序、选项标签、外部判断、图文描述、无关信息、评分量表）评测 13 个多模态决策模型及其骨干模型的稳定性与准确性变化。
AI.relevance_reason: 外部判断、一致/冲突描述与无关信息三类干预可用于核查多模态模型是否真正筛选视觉证据、还是走文本旁路或迎合提示；「决策不变但答案概率仍移动 4.56–11.55 个百分点」提示评价 LVR 时需超越准确率，测量内部状态对呈现变化的敏感度。
